activeIssue.rootCause: Mailbox Health emitted one identical TRUSTED_PROVIDER_SECURITY_ALERT warning for every matching authenticated provider envelope. It had no provider-native event identity, no privacy-safe alert classification, and no presentation aggregation contract, while the browser renders only indicator title/detail/severity. Exact duplicate observations therefore inflated warning cards and genuinely distinct provider alerts were visually indistinguishable.
